name: AssistantPane
description:
The assistant docked beside a page or opened as a window: a glass pane with the AI mark,
the title and the scope it is pinned to, header actions, then the conversation filling the
rest. Everything inside is container-aware down to 20rem; the pane sets no widths itself.
signature: ({ title: titleProp, scope, actions, working, children, className, ...rest }: AssistantPaneProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: actions
props.description: Ghost sm buttons before the window controls: new chat, history, open full page.

props.name: children
props.description: The conversation (a ConversationLog with surface="panel" and the composer footer).

props.name: working
props.description: Marks the assistant as working; motion follows the appearance preference.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
